summary: Iteration 82: Invoice Generation, SFTP Schedule, and Chunked Upload - All 40 backend tests passed (100%), all 19 frontend tests passed (100%). Complete implementation of P2 Invoice Generation with plan pricing, GST, usage metrics, and P3 SFTP Schedule + Chunked Upload features.

TEST_08_generate_invoice_success.notes: Creates invoice with plan pricing, returns invoice_id, invoice_number, total

TEST_10_get_invoice_detail.notes: Returns full detail with usage_metrics and plan_limits

TEST_F12_sidebar_nav.notes: Invoices link in sidebar ADMIN section

TEST_F15_status_badges.notes: paid, unpaid, overdue, cancelled badges displayed

P2_INVOICE_GENERATION: POST /api/invoices/generate - Creates invoice with plan pricing (trial=0, starter=29K, professional=99K, enterprise=249K INR)
GET /api/invoices - Lists invoices with all fields (number, company, plan, amounts, status, usage)
GET /api/invoices/{id} - Full invoice detail including usage_metrics (8 fields) and plan_limits
PUT /api/invoices/{id}/status - Update to paid/cancelled/overdue with payment_reference
GET /api/invoices/{id}/download - Returns styled HTML invoice (printable PDF via browser)
DELETE /api/invoices/{id} - Admin-only delete with 403 for non-admins
P3_SFTP_SCHEDULE: GET /api/data/sftp-schedule - Returns schedule config (enabled, frequency, hour, file_types, destination_path)
P3_CHUNKED_UPLOADS: POST /api/data/upload/init - Initialize chunked upload session with upload_id
POST /api/data/upload/chunk/{upload_id} - Upload individual chunk with progress tracking
POST /api/data/upload/complete/{upload_id} - Finalize and process (validates all chunks received)
FRONTEND_COMPONENTS: InvoiceManagement.jsx - Full invoice management page at /invoices
Invoice list with cards showing number, status badge, amount, dates, plan
Detail panel with usage metrics grid (8 metrics) and financial breakdown
Generate Invoice form with optional description/amount
Mark as Paid, Print/Download, Delete action buttons
Sidebar has 'Invoices' link in ADMIN section

seed_data_creation: Multiple test invoices created during testing (GMP-202604-DEMO-0001 through 0007+)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 82 verified complete Invoice Generation (P2), SFTP Schedule (P3), and Chunked Upload (P3) implementations. Invoice pricing: trial=0, starter=29K, professional=99K, enterprise=249K INR + 18% GST. Invoice number format: GMP-YYYYMM-TENANT-NNNN. Download returns styled HTML (not PDF) - designed for browser print-to-PDF. SFTP schedule stores config in sftp_schedules collection. Chunked upload uses in-memory _chunk_storage dict with 5-min cleanup. All endpoints require authentication. Tenant isolation verified for invoices.
